reason: Frequent medium-amplitude saccades across both vertical and horizontal directions, many shifts between mid-page and near-top/near-bottom regions, and repeated revisits to mid-screen bands resemble scanning of heterogeneous web layouts more than the more line-structured, band-limited patterns of READ/WRITE or the focused central bands of WATCH/PLAY. SEARCH tends to have longer stable fixations at a few vertical levels; here the gaze roams broadly and continuously like general web browsing.
